title: Flip the Claude agent-file drift check: a model pin is the drift
action: In validate_agent_files_drift, split the Claude root's verdict from opencode's: for .claude/agents/<agent>.md a present model: frontmatter line is the drift (legacy pinned file — re-render via bee onboard --apply), a file without one is clean, and the agent-file-malformed no-model arm no longer applies to Claude; the opencode arm keeps the existing expected-model comparison byte-for-byte. Update status_full tests accordingly.
